name: eden
description: Eden, a personal digital garden. Apps in apps/* are composed from the packages in packages/*.

scripts.dev: cross-env EDEN_ENV=development tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json -- --features desktop --features devtools
scripts.dev:ios: cross-env EDEN_ENV=development TAURI_DEV_HOST=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0) tauri ios dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json --features mobile
scripts.dev:android: cross-env EDEN_ENV=development TAURI_DEV_HOST=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0) tauri android dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json --features mobile
scripts.build: yarn workspace @eden/ui-kit run build && yarn workspace @eden/desktop run build && yarn workspace @eden/mobile run build
scripts.build:production: cross-env EDEN_ENV=production tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.prod.conf.json --features desktop
scripts.build:staging: cross-env EDEN_ENV=staging tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.staging.conf.json --features desktop
scripts.build:ios:adhoc: cross-env EDEN_ENV=production tauri ios build --config src-tauri/tauri.prod.conf.json --export-method ad-hoc --features mobile
scripts.build:android:apk: cross-env EDEN_ENV=production tauri android build --apk true --features mobile
scripts.check: yarn workspace @eden/ui-kit run check && yarn workspace @eden/shared run check && yarn workspace @eden/desktop run check && yarn workspace @eden/mobile run check
scripts.check:cargo: cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features desktop && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-apple-ios --no-default-features --features mobile
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features desktop -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-apple-ios --no-default-features --features mobile -- -D warnings

lint-staged.packages/ui-kit/src/lib/tokens/*.json: yarn tokens && yarn icons && git add packages/ui-kit/src/lib/styles packages/ui-kit/src/lib/tokens packages/ui-kit/src/lib/icons/icons.ts packages/ui-kit/.storybook/preview-head.html
